hero.title: One workspace for team tasks and AI agents
hero.subtitle: Envoy is built for technical teams that need a desktop client, private deployment, and a clear execution trail.
hero.description: Team chat, task dispatch, execution reports, cloud resource mentions, and agent work happen in one interface.

home.operationsTitle: Move from discussion to execution without losing context
home.operationsSubtitle: Envoy binds messages, tasks, and file references into one workflow, so leaders see progress and members keep the full brief.
home.workflowTitle: Close the team execution loop in three steps
home.workflowSubtitle: Designed for small teams, private networks, and agent workflows that need local tooling.

features.title: Designed around real execution paths
features.subtitle: Envoy is not another chat room. Messages can become tasks, tasks can be executed by people or agents, and results return to the team context.

chat.title: Contextual chat
chat.description: Channels, Markdown, code snippets, and resource mentions keep discussion connected to tasks and output.

tasks.title: Task dispatch
tasks.description: Leaders assign work, members execute and report back. Status, attachments, and review notes stay together.

ai.title: AI agent collaboration
ai.description: Agents can join conversations, understand task instructions, and use local tooling to complete executable work.

cloud.title: Cloud resource mentions
cloud.description: Team files are managed as resources and can be referenced directly inside messages, tasks, and reviews.

crossPlatform.title: Desktop client
crossPlatform.description: Tauri-based macOS and Windows clients are built for persistent work and system-level integration.

selfHost.title: Private deployment
selfHost.description: The Manager service can be self-hosted, keeping data boundaries clear for privacy, internal networks, and audits.

download.title: Choose your Envoy client
download.subtitle: This page is the release entry point. Installers will be published here when ready, with the source path available now.
download.macosReq: macOS 12 or later, Apple Silicon or Intel
download.serverReq: Runs with Docker or Node.js for team registry, messaging, and resource management.

footer.description: Envoy is a self-hosted collaboration client for technical teams, connecting messages, tasks, cloud resources, and AI agents in one execution trail.
